title: Steam Works / paired Railcraft HP plant and gallery interface
coordinates: City-local NW origin; +X east,+Z south,+Y up; civil Y0 = future surface S. Bounds inclusive; world origin/S/rotation unassigned. Shell-local X/Z = city minus22.
design_basis: HV-era utility plant, Railcraft high-pressure boilers per user. Two36-HP solid-firebox boilers confirmed by the user; commission one first.

T.title: Huge Stainless Steel Fluid Pipe / steam

P.title: HV 4-slot Battery Buffer
P.battery_tier: HV; specific battery item/chemistry chosen in game

objects.title: Controlled fuel buffer / hopper / lever
objects.notes: Lever powers pedestal beside hopper. Lock hopper while preparing. Chest is not face-adjacent to any firebox; RC auto-pull cannot bypass this hopper via that chest. Hopper already-held/internal fuel still burns after locking.

objects.title: Controlled fuel buffer / hopper / lever
objects.notes: Lever powers pedestal beside hopper. Lock hopper while preparing. Chest is not face-adjacent to any firebox; RC auto-pull cannot bypass this hopper via that chest. Hopper already-held/internal fuel still burns after locking.

objects.title: HV backup steam turbine
objects.default: Steam branch disconnected until backup mode is commissioned

ports.contract: Upstream Water Works must actively supply water; no unverified infinite source is assumed. Target at least18 L/t sustained for both hot boilers plus refill margin; pipe nameplate80 L/t.
Huge Stainless Steel header,1440 L/t nameplate. Keep east connection closed until receiving network is ready.
Second independent header,1440 L/t nameplate. Do not merge both into a single smaller line.
512 V packet source, initial1A buffer output; delivered packet voltage is reduced by explicit cable loss. No LV/MV machine may connect directly.
Upstream coke plant must insert accepted solid fuel into this item network; GT item pipes alone do not pull fuel from an unconfigured source chest.
